gender.label: female

gender.reasoning: Subject refers to herself as a girl who will get a job as a woman engineer.

school.label: Mixed sex
school.evidence: it was just a big normal comprehensive school.
school.reasoning: Comprehensive and explicitly not an all-girls school, so mixed.

year.label: Part B/Year 2
year.evidence: I’ve only had like about 3 modules of that and I’m in my 2nd year – at the end now.

dept.label: Civil & Building Engineering

highsal.label: disagree

special.label: agree

gooddeg.label: agree

family.label: disagree
family.evidence: No, my dad’s a nurse, my mum’s a social worker.

hobbies.label: disagree

mother.label: disagree
mother.evidence: My parents said they didn’t have a clue.
mother.reasoning: Mother did not actively encourage engineering (only later praised the uni); parents 'didn't have a clue'.

father.label: disagree
father.evidence: my dad’s not very engineering minded – he’s never really taught me
father.reasoning: Father not engineering-minded and 'didn't have a clue'; did not encourage.

careers.label: Strongly agree
careers.evidence: I went to see a careers advisor and she said, have you thought of engineering? … careers advisors kind of put the idea in my head
careers.reasoning: Careers advisor explicitly planted the idea and is named as biggest influence.

teacher.label: agree
teacher.evidence: my Physics teacher as well – she’s a civil engineer
teacher.reasoning: Names physics teacher (a civil engineer) as a big influence on the choice.

discoura.label: no
discoura.evidence: they kind of thought it was a really good idea

practica.label: disagree

relevanc.label: Strongly agree

pleased.label: neither agree nor disagree

competit.label: agree

interper.label: agree

supppers.label: very dissatisfied
supppers.evidence: just not him. He’s terrible. … he’s just not a very good people person really

friends.label: very satisfied

friends.reasoning: Very positive about friends/mates on the course who are her biggest influence.

theory.label: dissatisfied
theory.evidence: They are so theoretical – well that’s a bad thing isn’t it?
theory.reasoning: Dissatisfied with the heavily theoretical content.

practwk.label: dissatisfied
practwk.evidence: I just wish we had more practical modules
practwk.reasoning: Wants more practical work, dissatisfied with the amount provided.

designwk.label: very satisfied
designwk.evidence: It was engineering design, it was group work but it was so good … it was just really good, it was really fun
designwk.reasoning: Very positive about the design module she did.

groupwk.label: neither satisfied nor dissatisfied
groupwk.evidence: it’s not that I don’t like it, I just – sometimes when people don’t pull their weight it really annoys me
groupwk.reasoning: Mixed feelings on group work: enjoys good projects but frustrated by free-riders.

assess.label: disagree
assess.evidence: So that’s 80% exams … it’s just that I wish they’d been worth more, really.
assess.reasoning: Coursework/exam balance is wrong (too exam-heavy), not just right.

placemen.label: yes
placemen.evidence: I’m doing the year out with the same company
placemen.reasoning: Sponsored student doing the year-out placement.

money.label: Strongly agree
money.evidence: So I could have some money. … I also like some money really, so I can save up
money.reasoning: Money is the explicit primary reason for the sponsorship/placement route.

experien.label: Strongly agree
experien.evidence: the good things will be learning more – just getting more practical experience really.
experien.reasoning: Wants the placement for work/practical experience.

jobprosp.label: agree
jobprosp.evidence: So I could get my foot in the door when I leave, without having to do interviews and things.
jobprosp.reasoning: Placement to improve job chances after university.

jobdecid.label: Strongly agree
jobdecid.evidence: Well more idea about what I’m doing when I leave – like what field I want to go into
jobdecid.reasoning: Wants placement to help decide future direction.

industry.label: agree
industry.evidence: I know what the programme is and things like that, because I wouldn’t have known that otherwise
industry.reasoning: Placement gives an idea of what industry is really like.

indchart.label: disagree
indchart.evidence: that’s what I thought we had to do and now I’m like you can do ok without being chartered
indchart.reasoning: Chartership not a driver; she has realised it isn't necessary.

wkexp.label: agree
wkexp.evidence: I went on a summer placement and worked in a sewage works
wkexp.reasoning: Already has prior work experience in engineering via the summer placement.

placothe.label: compulsory
placothe.evidence: I think you do. I think it’s kind of like, if you don’t then you’re really bad or something.
placothe.reasoning: As a sponsored student she believes the placement is effectively required.

carpath.label: project management
carpath.evidence: I liked the management aspect best … Something where I could go to organise things
carpath.reasoning: Prefers the management/organising side (site managing), choosing project management over design.

workrole.label: managerial
workrole.evidence: I’m thinking about maybe going into site managing, being a site manager
workrole.reasoning: Prefers a managerial work role (site manager).

travel.label: very important
travel.evidence: Something where I could go to organise things, and it would involve a lot of travel.
travel.reasoning: Travel is central to her ideal career and she'd love to work abroad.

salary.label: unimportant
salary.evidence: if you work for money, then what’s the point?
salary.reasoning: Dismissive of the site workers' money-obsession; salary not an important driver for her.

people.label: important
people.evidence: I just don’t think I’d like the idea of people not liking me … I like people to like me.
people.reasoning: The people she works with and being liked matter to her in the work context.
